## Selected Work

### Construction Website

A premium corporate website developed for a construction company to showcase its services, generate leads, and provide a responsive digital experience with smooth GSAP animations.

Technologies:
React, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Web Development.

### Restaurant Website

A modern restaurant website designed to showcase the restaurant's menu, services, and brand while providing an engaging and responsive experience for customers.

Technologies:
React, GSAP, Custom CSS, Responsive Web Development.

### Clinic Website

A modern clinic website developed to present healthcare services and information through a clean, responsive interface with smooth animations and a patient-focused user experience.

Technologies:
React, GSAP, Custom CSS, Responsive Web Development.

### Custom CRM Platform

A full-stack CRM web application developed to manage business data and workflows through a responsive dashboard interface with API integration and MongoDB database management.

Technologies:
React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, TanStack Query, Custom CSS.
